thread.title: Fight at Prosser party ends with teen stabbed multiple times - NewsBreak

author: Cameron Probert
title: Fight at Prosser party ends with teen stabbed multiple times - NewsBreak
text:
By Cameron Probert ,
9 hours ago Prosser police arrested Ruben Mejia after he allegedly stabbed a 17-year-old several times during a fight at a Prosser party. Courtesy Prosser Police A 19-year-old is accused of stabbing a teen multiple times during a fight at a Prosser party.
The fight broke out between Ruben J. Mejia, of Grandview, and another teen about 1:30 a.m. Saturday during a party in the 2400 block of Lee Road, according to court documents. Video of the brawl allegedly shows the 17-year-old standing over Mejia, punching him. When the teen is pulled away, Mejia stands up and allegedly has a knife in his hand.
Police reports and court documents don’t state what started the fight, but once officers arrived on the scene, they discovered both Mejia and the wounded teen were gone. Someone drove the 17-year-old to Prosser Memorial Hospital and he was then flown to Kadlec Regional Medical Center, court documents said.
The 17-year-old was reported to be in stable condition, according to a Prosser police Facebook post.
Prosser officers found Mejia on Easy Street about 4:30 a.m. the same morning, after someone noticed a man they didn’t know in the 100 block, police said in a news release.
He was booked into the Benton County jail on suspicion of first-degree assault as well as several warrants from other counties, jail records show. His bail was set at $200,000 for the Benton County case.
Police are continuing to investigate the fight. Video shows several people recording it, and they are hoping anyone with video or other information would contact. Sgt. Thomas Forsyth at tforsyth@ci.prosser.wa.us or (509) 786-1500.
